description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Filter, which models a filter used in HTML purification, providing mechanisms for pre- and post-processing of HTML content within the HTML Purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter
classes.description: A class representing a filter that can modify HTML output either before or after it is processed by HTML Purifier. It includes a name attribute and two methods: preFilter and postFilter for handling HTML content.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Method meant to be overridden to process HTML content before it is purified. Currently, it returns the HTML unchanged.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Method meant to be overridden to process HTML content after it has been purified. Currently, it returns the HTML unchanged.
